newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end firmer, buoyed by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end firmer, buoyed by Wall Street.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed mixed with the indices marginally firmer after a quiet session during which gains in U.S. and other markets helped reverse selling pressure. * General index up 0.58 points, 0.16 percent, to 373.33. * Ibex-35 index gained 5.81 points, 0.14 percent, to 4,277.06. * Telefonica accounted for 22 percent of total trade and rose 15 pesetas to 2,460 with around four million shares exchanging hands. Repsol rose 45 pesetas, 1.02 percent, to 4,470.
"It's been a pretty boring day, with an imporovement at the end of the session based on external references, but without new buying interest on the bourse," said a trader at ABN-Amro.
